title: Porsche Brings Wireless EV Charging to Production Vehicles
detail: Porsche becomes the first major automaker to introduce wireless EV charging in a production vehicle, marking a significant milestone for consumer adoption of inductive charging technology.

media.caption: Porsche wireless EV charging system in production vehicle

title: Self-Loading Tech for Bulk Cargo Vessels Cuts Freight Emissions by 50%
detail: New self-loading technology for bulk cargo vessels achieves a 50% reduction in freight emissions, representing a significant decarbonization milestone for the shipping industry.

media.caption: Hybrid freight vessel with self-loading technology
